name: Cucumber (Gherkin)
description: Gherkin syntax highlighting, a new feature file template and format on save for Cucumber .feature files.

settings.title: Format on save
settings.description: Format .feature and .testcase files when you save them: indents, tables and JSON doc strings.

settings.title: Indent size
settings.description: Spaces per indent level; 0 indents with a tab.

settings.title: Keep doc strings as written
settings.description: Leave the lines between """ or ''' untouched. Turn off to re-indent them with the rest of the file.

settings.title: Indent overrides
settings.description: JSON object mapping a line prefix to an indent level, "relative" (same as the next line) or "relativeUp" (same as the previous line). Use it for non-English keywords.
